results.name: Two-step signed GOF suppression in compact process
results.hypothesis: Inhibiting a target can suppress a GOF disease driver through a two-step same-sign regulatory chain localized to one compact process.
results.body: drug decreases target; two same-sign SIGNOR steps reach GOF driver; all three genes share compact process
results.mechanism_rationale: Drug, two regulatory signs, and disease-variant direction compose into a corrective effect across a three-gene process.
results.trapi_notes: Positive paths are TRAPI-expressible; sign composition, source, variant form, node identity, and process degree require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(target:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(target)
MATCH (target)-[regulation1:REGULATES]->(middle:Gene)
MATCH (middle)-[regulation2:REGULATES]->(driver:Gene)
MATCH (driver)-[association:ASSOCIATED_WITH]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (target)-[:INVOLVED_IN]->(process:BiologicalProcess)
      <-[:INVOLVED_IN]-(middle)
MATCH (driver)-[:INVOLVED_IN]->(process)
WHERE target <> middle
  AND middle <> driver
  AND target <> driver
  AND 'infores:signor' IN
      coalesce(regulation1.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND 'infores:signor' IN
      coalesce(regulation2.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND regulation1.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND regulation2.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND regulation1.object_direction_qualifier IN
      ['upregulated', 'downregulated']
  AND regulation2.object_direction_qualifier IN
      ['upregulated', 'downregulated']
  AND regulation1.object_direction_qualifier =
      regulation2.object_direction_qualifier
  AND 'infores:gene2phenotype' IN
      coalesce(association.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND association.subject_form_or_variant_qualifier = 'gain_of_function_variant_form'
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND process._miner_gene_member_degree <= 100
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Process- and anatomy-localized two-step GOF suppression
results.hypothesis: Two-step GOF suppression is most credible when the full regulatory chain is expressed in affected disease anatomy.
results.body: R192 plus Bgee expression of target, middle, and GOF driver in disease anatomy
results.mechanism_rationale: The full signed chain is localized by both process and affected tissue, reducing context-free regulatory propagation.
results.trapi_notes: Positive paths are TRAPI-expressible; sign algebra, three-node shared anatomy, Bgee provenance, and process degree require Cypher.

MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(target)
MATCH (target)-[regulation1:REGULATES]->(middle:Gene)
MATCH (middle)-[regulation2:REGULATES]->(driver:Gene)

      <-[:INVOLVED_IN]-(middle)

MATCH (target)-[target_expression:EXPRESSED_IN]->

      <-[middle_expression:EXPRESSED_IN]-(middle)

  AND 'infores:signor' IN

  AND 'infores:gene2phenotype' IN

  AND association.subject_form_or_variant_qualifier = 'gain_of_function_variant_form'
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
